title: SenseVTT cue payload
description: The one-line JSON payload of a SenseVTT cue. `start` and `end` describe the event itself; ramp and lead margins are separate fields and never move the cue timing.

id.description: Cue identifier, unique within the file.

start.description: Event start, in seconds of media time.

end.description: Event end, in seconds of media time.

anchor.description: What fixed the timestamp. `approx` means the player widens its margins.

preview.description: One spoiler-light line, shown for "Tell me".

lead_s.description: Heads-up lead time in seconds. Default 5.

pre_s.description: Ramp margin before the event, in seconds. Default for flash cues: 1.5.

post_s.description: Ramp margin after the event, in seconds. Default for flash cues: 1.0.

audio_ref.description: Audio description clip, for `ad` cues only.

evidence.description: Free-form detector values and agent reasoning, for auditability.
